verdict.rationale: Vanta's own GRC marketing says controls can be cross-mapped across its pre-built (or customized) frameworks. It also says controls are reused and automated across multiple frameworks, which covers the core of SOC 2 work counting toward ISO 27001 and HIPAA. The evidence is marketing-level only: nothing documents how evidence propagates automatically or how the overlap between frameworks is shown. Missing for 10: documentation of an overlap/coverage view across frameworks, explicit confirmation that evidence collected for one framework automatically satisfies another's requirements, in-depth first-party docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, controls and evidence map ACROSS frameworks — work done for SOC 2 counts toward ISO 27001 and HIPAA automatically, with the overlap shown

citations.quote: you can cross-map your controls across [frameworks_count] pre-built frameworks (or ones you've customized)
